conflicts.description: Legacy sources disagree on label: 'ROM Started' versus 'Ring #2 Flashers'.

mechanisms.behavior: Ringmaster Pop-Up Head Linear motor raises/lowers Ringmaster head. Sol 22 enables motor, Sol 39 controls direction. Callback UpdateRM moves ringmaster.z and collision walls based on position.
mechanisms.label: Ringmaster Pop-Up Head

mechanisms.behavior: Ringmaster Magnet Grabs ball at Ringmaster head; custom kick logic on release via SolRingmasterMagnet sub
mechanisms.label: Ringmaster Magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Spin Magnet No solenoid assigned; used for wobble/shake physics on ringmaster head
mechanisms.label: Spin Magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Ramp Ball Lock (3 ball) 3-ball virtual lock on upper ramp; released by Lock Post solenoid (16)
mechanisms.label: Ramp Ball Lock (3 ball)

mechanisms.behavior: Backbox Prize Wheel / Bell Spinner Custom physics simulation; ball launched by Backbox Kicker (sol 2) interacts with spinning disc. Disc has 5 spinner balls for collision detection. Bell at sw11.
mechanisms.label: Backbox Prize Wheel / Bell Spinner
